name: file_length
description: Hard cap at 400 lines per file

name: one_widget_per_file
description: One widget class per file (excludes State<T>)

name: no_raw_alpha_integer
description: Bans integer alpha in Color.withValues(alpha: N) where N > 1.0

name: late_controllers_not_final
description: Prevents late final on animation/scroll controllers

name: callback_present_tense
description: Callback params must be present tense (onTap not onTapped)

name: no_color_scheme_access
description: Bans direct .colorScheme access; use design tokens

name: no_f_prefix_on_project_widgets
description: F prefix reserved for upstream forui components

name: no_material_colors_constant
description: Bans Colors.* palette; use Color(0xFF...) or AppColors

name: no_material_widgets
description: Bans raw Material widgets; use project replacements

name: no_text_theme_access
description: Bans direct .textTheme access; use design tokens

name: screen_class_suffix
description: Screen classes must use Screen suffix not Page

name: widgets_via_barrel_import
description: Import core widgets through barrel file only
